title: Client Dinner
logline: Michael and Jan take a county purchasing director to dinner, where Michael's rambling wins the deal and Jan kisses him in the parking lot, while Jim, left in charge for the afternoon, uses his power for nothing but a desk swap with Pam.
outline: A: Michael and Jan pitch the county's purchasing director; Jan's slides fail, Michael's sincere rambling wins, and Jan kisses him, then says it never happened. B: Michael leaves Jim in charge; Jim and Pam swap desks for the afternoon, and Dwight attempts a coup. C: Kelly tells everyone she's dating Ryan, who was not consulted. Order: cold, A, B, A, C, B, A, C, B, A, B, tag
storySoFar: Michael and Jan took Harold Pettibone, purchasing director for Lackawanna County schools, to dinner at The Beef & Barrel; Jan's slides failed, Michael's story about his childhood comic 'Agent Michael Scarn' won the deal, and in the parking lot Jan kissed him, then said it never happened. Michael is bursting to tell someone. The deal may help decide whether Scranton or Stamford closes; Michael promised nobody would lose their job. Jim was Acting Regional Manager for the afternoon: he gave everyone ten minutes and swapped desks with Pam; Dwight's coup failed against Michael's sticky note. Kelly is telling everyone she's dating Ryan, who says they're not. Dwight runs a Loyalty Task Force with Angela; Jim kept Pam's drawing of the office; Pam doesn't remember kissing Jim's cheek at the Dundies.

extras.name: Harold Pettibone
extras.title: Purchasing Director, Lackawanna County
extras.voice: Weary, literal county bureaucrat who has sat through a thousand pitches and trusts nobody with slides.

stateChanges.progress: Michael won the county deal; Jan kissed him in the parking lot and says it never happened
Kelly announced they're dating; Ryan was not consulted
Jim and Pam swapped desks for an afternoon; it was the best day either has had

stateChanges.status: They kissed after the county deal; Jan insists it never happened
Kelly says they're dating; Ryan says they're not

stateChanges.text: Michael's childhood comic hero: Agent Michael Scarn
Harold Pettibone of Lackawanna County signed with Scranton

beats.text: Ooh, crossword. What've you got? I'm very good. I've seen a crossword.
Seven letters. 'One who runs an office.'
Michael.
That's seven letters, but it's 'manager.'
Agree to disagree. Put 'Michael' in pencil.

scenes.recap: Jan arrives to prep the county pitch and tells Michael to let her do the talking.

beats.text: Harold Pettibone buys paper for every school in the county. This deal could decide which branch survives.
I have slides. You will smile, nod, and say nothing.
Smile, nod, nothing. I'm like a bobblehead. A silent, sexy bobblehead.
Starting now, Michael.

lines: Michael is... unique. Clients either love him or report him.
Tonight I need them to love him silently.

scenes.recap: On his way out, Michael leaves Jim in charge; Dwight is outraged, and Jim's first act is to give everyone a ten-minute break.

beats.text: I'm off to a very important dinner with a very important lady. Jim, you're in charge.
Jim? Michael, I am the Assistant to the Regional Manager.
And Jim is the Acting Regional Manager. Acting beats assisting. Like in movies.
As my first act as Acting Regional Manager: everybody take ten minutes.

lines: The line of succession is clear. It is me. It has always been me.
Michael is testing me. This is a test. I will pass it by seizing power.

scenes.recap: Jan's slide pitch puts Harold Pettibone to sleep; Michael is visibly dying to talk.

beats.caption: flips through a binder of pie charts

beats.text: As you can see, our delivery reliability is ninety-eight point four percent.
Staples said ninety-nine.
Staples is a big-box retailer that doesn't know your name.
Neither do you. You called me Howard twice.

beats.caption: nods, smiles, and silently vibrates with things to say

scenes.recap: Kelly announces to Toby that she and Ryan are dating; Ryan was not consulted.

beats.text: Toby, I have to disclose something. For HR. Ryan and I are dating.
We're not.
He's shy. We had coffee. In the kitchen. Together.
We were both getting coffee at the same time.
I'll... make a note.

lines: When you know, you know. And I know. I've known since Tuesday.
Ryan doesn't know yet. That's so romantic.

scenes.recap: Acting Manager Jim decrees a desk swap with Pam; she takes his seat across from Dwight, and loves it.

beats.text: New policy. For one afternoon, Pam and I switch desks. For morale.
Hi, Dwight. I'm your new desk mate. Want to hear about my weekend?
This is a hostile work environment. I'm writing it down.
Is that a beet on your mug? What kind of beet is it?

lines: Jim's desk has a great view. Of Dwight. But also of the window.
And you can see reception from here. It looks lonely. Huh.

scenes.recap: Michael breaks his silence with a long, sincere story about his mother and a ream of paper, and Harold signs.

beats.text: Harold. Can I tell you a story? When I was nine, my mom bought me a ream of paper. For my birthday.
Michael.
I drew a comic book. Five hundred pages. About a hero called Agent Michael Scarn. It was terrible. It was everything.
Those kids in your schools? That's their ream. Don't give them Staples. Give them someone who remembers.
Where do I sign?

scenes.recap: Kelly brings Ryan a 'couples lunch'; he tries to be honest, and she hears it as a compliment.

beats.caption: hands Ryan a sandwich cut into a heart

beats.text: Kelly, I need to be honest. I'm not really looking for anything right now.
Oh my God, you're so honest. That's literally my type.
That's not... okay.

scenes.recap: Dwight calls an emergency meeting to seize power; Pam produces Michael's sticky note naming Jim, and the coup collapses.

beats.text: Michael has been unreachable for two hours. By law, power passes to the Assistant to the Regional Manager.
Which law?
Schrute law.

beats.caption: holds up a sticky note: JIM IS IN CHARGE. NOT DWIGHT. - M

beats.text: The coup is over, Dwight. Sit down.
Can we keep the ten minutes?

scenes.recap: In the parking lot after the deal, a giddy Jan kisses Michael, then tells him it never happened.

beats.text: That was... the stupidest thing I've ever seen. And it worked.
Agent Michael Scarn never fails.

beats.caption: grabs his lapels and kisses him

beats.text: This never happened.
What never happened?
Exactly.

lines: Nothing happened tonight. Nothing. At all. Happened.

scenes.recap: At five, Jim and Pam switch back; it was the best afternoon either of them has had at work.

beats.text: The Acting Regional Manager is now stepping down. Thank you for your service, Chief of Staff.
Best administration in Dunder Mifflin history.
Ten-minute break and a desk swap. They'll write books about us.

lines: Would I want Michael's job? No. Absolutely not.
I'd want the desk swap thing again, though.

scenes.recap: The next morning, Michael asks Dwight if he can keep a secret; Dwight says no.

beats.text: THE NEXT MORNING
Dwight. Can you keep a secret?
No.
Good. Neither can I.
